summary: Completed comprehensive testing of iteration 11 features: VIN Scanner with confidence score, Dashboard stats API, Customers/Vehicles list APIs, Command Center modal with 6 tabs including Settings, Quick Add bluetooth button, Tower Talk button, and Inquiry Type buttons. All 24 backend tests pass. All frontend UI elements verified working correctly.

seed_data_creation: Used existing test data - 2 customers (John Smith, Josh Cherry), 2 vehicles (Mazda CX-50, Tesla Model S)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 11 features fully tested. Backend APIs verified: GET /api/vin/decode/{vin} returns vehicle data with confidence_score in validation object (tested Tesla 5YJSA1E29HF000001 and Corvette 1G1YY22G965104756), GET /api/dashboard/stats returns customers and vehicles counts, GET /api/customers returns customer list with count, GET /api/vehicles returns vehicle list with count. Frontend: Check Engine button opens Command Center modal with 6 tabs (Dashboard, Customers, Inventory, Import, CRM, Settings), Settings tab has Dealership Profile and Your Profile sections with form fields, VIN Scanner modal opens with Scan Barcode and Enter Manually options, VIN decode shows confidence badge (60% for test VINs), vehicle specs, safety features, and save options (Inventory/Trade-In), Quick Add bluetooth button opens customer form modal with all fields, Tower Talk button visible after customer selection, Inquiry Type buttons visible (New Lead, Price Question, Availability, Trade-In, Financing, Test Drive, Follow Up, Objection). Luxury ambient lighting styles present in CSS with wood grain textures and amber glow effects.
